name: Button: Go to Advanced Find Layout ( EntityName )
purpose: Opens the advanced find layout for an entity name (customer, opportunity or contact): remembers the current layout number in $$Find.ReturnToLayoutNumber, switches triggers off, goes to the find layout, enters find mode, resizes the window and switches triggers back on. Shows an error for any other name.

open_question: The triggers are switched with the Triggers.Disable and Triggers.Enable custom functions (not shown); if the script stops in between, triggers stay off.

name: Menu: Perform Advanced Find
purpose: Menu action behind the advanced find menu: with triggers off, performs the find the user entered, then calls Handle Advanced Find Result.
open_question: The find criteria are whatever the user typed in the find layout, so no field is named here.

name: Menu: Advanced Find - Constrain
purpose: Menu action for Constrain: with triggers off, constrains the found set by the user's find request, then calls Handle Advanced Find Result.

name: Menu: Advanced Find - Extend
purpose: Menu action for Extend: with triggers off, extends the found set by the user's find request, then calls Handle Advanced Find Result.

name: _Handle Advanced Find Result
purpose: After an advanced find: when nothing was found, asks whether to try again (re-enters find mode) or cancels; otherwise returns to the stored layout and hides the toolbars.
